briefdescription.para: A move ends when it is closer than this to the target and slow enough (1/1024 microstep).
Value of sstep_ctx::ready after a successful sstep_init() ("STPC").

detaileddescription.para: A zeroed or never initialized instance holds another value: every function but sstep_init() then returns SSTEP_ERR_STATE instead of using an empty configuration.

Driver state, NULL if drv is NULL.

memberdef.name: sstep_bridge_map

briefdescription.para: Map requested phase voltages to leg compare values (averaged power stage).

detaileddescription.para:
The voltage vector is scaled down with its direction kept when the stage cannot produce it: full bridge |a|, |b| <= 1, shared leg max(a,b,0) - min(a,b,0) <= 1, a and b relative to the measured bus voltage. Shared leg: common leg centred.
topology
Power stage topology (compiled in).
va vb
Requested phase voltages [pu of V_base].
inv_vbus
V_base / bus voltage.
vbus
Bus voltage [pu of V_base], 0 .. 2.
period
Compare value for 100 % duty cycle.
out
Result.

briefdescription.para: One slow loop period of the motion generator: trapezoidal velocity profile with one-period look-ahead braking for moves, exact stop on the target.

parameterdescription.para: Motion state; pos and vel are updated.

simplesect.para: SSTEP_MOTION_DONE when a move reached its target in this period, else 0.

briefdescription.para: Reset the stall detector when the outputs are enabled: empty voltage history, filters at zero, current history from the last measurement.

memberdef.name: sstep_stall_observe

briefdescription.para: Back-EMF observer of one fast loop period (fast loop, current drive).

detaileddescription.para:
Uses the voltage computed two periods ago (applied during the period that just ended), the measured currents and the commanded angle, then stores v_applied.
m
Driver state; i_meas holds the currents of this period.
sc
Sine and cosine of the commanded angle of this period.
v_applied
Phase voltages computed in this period [pu V].

briefdescription.para: Stall decision of one slow loop period, against the command of the period that just ended (vel_cmd, ff_cmd).

simplesect.para: true when the stall condition has persisted for stall_time_ms.

briefdescription.para: Fill the observer fields of a status (zero when stall detection is off).
